message.content:
Do a thorough audit of the Rankora auth page components. Read EVERY file completely:

1. `src/components/auth/AuthLayout.tsx`
2. `src/components/auth/AuthLeftPanel.tsx`
3. `src/components/auth/SignInForm.tsx`
4. `src/components/auth/SignUpForm.tsx`
5. `src/components/auth/ForgotPasswordForm.tsx`
6. `src/components/auth/SocialAuthButtons.tsx`
7. `src/components/auth/TrustBadges.tsx`
8. `src/components/auth/Divider.tsx`
9. `src/legacy-pages/Auth.tsx`
10. `src/index.css` (full file — all CSS variables)
11. `tailwind.config.ts` (full file)
12. `src/components/ui/input.tsx` (to see the default input styling)
13. `src/components/ui/button.tsx` (to see button variants)

For each component, report:
- Any hardcoded colors that don't match the CSS variable system (e.g. `#1a1a2e`, `text-gray-600` instead of using `text-foreground`, `bg-background` etc.)
- Any inconsistent border-radius (some use `rounded-[10px]`, others use Tailwind tokens)
- Missing dark mode support (hardcoded light colors)
- Missing focus states or keyboard accessibility
- Missing aria labels
- Inconsistent spacing patterns
- Missing loading/error states
- Any CSS classes that won't work with the Tailwind config
- Mobile responsiveness issues
- Animation performance concerns

Also check:
- Does the auth page respect the existing dark mode toggle?
- Are the navy colors (#1a1a2e, #2d2b55) defined as CSS variables or hardcoded?
- Is the indigo-500 from Tailwind matching the brand primary color?

Report ALL findings with specific file:line references.

content.text: Perfect! Now I have all the information needed. Let me compile a comprehensive audit report. ## THOROUGH AUTH PAGE COMPONENTS AUDIT ### CRITICAL FINDINGS #### 1. HARDCODED NAVY COLORS - NOT DEFINED AS CSS VARIABLES **SEVERITY: HIGH** - Breaks dark mode consistency and design token system | File | Line(s) | Issue | |------|---------|-------| | AuthLeftPanel.tsx | 108, 144 | `bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1a1a2e] to-[#2d2b55]` - Hardcoded navy colors | | SignInForm.tsx | 149 | `bg-[#1a1a2e]` with `dark:bg-indigo-600` fallback - hardcoded light mode only | | SignUpForm.tsx | 273 | Same pattern: `bg-[#1a1a2e]` with `dark:bg-indigo-600` | | ForgotPasswordForm.tsx | 78, 119 | Same pattern: hardcoded `#1a1a2e` and `#2d2b55` | **Why this is broken:** - Navy colors (#1a1a2e, #2d2b55) are NOT defined in `index.css` CSS variable system - These should be added to `:root` and `.dark` selector in `index.css` - Current implementation forces light mode navy regardless of dark mode setting - The `dark:` variants don't actually work on these arbitrary colors **Fix needed:** Add to `index.css`: ```css --rk-auth-panel: 220 14% 18%; /* navy equivalent in HSL */ --rk-auth-panel-alt: 250 20% 27%; /* #2d2b55 equivalent */ ``` --- #### 2. INCONSISTENT BUTTON STYLING BETWEEN COMPONENTS **SEVERITY: MEDIUM** - No single "source of truth" for auth buttons | Component | Button Type | Style | |-----------|------------|-------| | SignInForm.tsx:146-153 | Submit | `bg-[#1a1a2e]` + custom hover/active logic | | SignUpForm.tsx:156-161 | Step 1 Continue | `bg-indigo-500` (uses Tailwind) | | SignUpForm.tsx:197-202 | Step 2 Continue | `bg-indigo-500` (uses Tailwind) | | SignUpForm.tsx:267-279 | Create Account | `bg-[#1a1a2e]` (hardcoded) | | ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:75-81 | Success CTA | `bg-[#1a1a2e]` (hardcoded) | | ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:116-125 | Reset Link Submit | `bg-[#1a1a2e]` (hardcoded) | **Issue:** Primary CTAs inconsistently use either hardcoded navy or indigo-500. Should be a single, reusable Button component. --- #### 3. INCONSISTENT BORDER-RADIUS IMPLEMENTATION **SEVERITY: MEDIUM** - Mixed rounded values create visual inconsistency | Component | Border Radius | Count | |-----------|--------------|-------| | All inputs in auth forms | `rounded-[10px]` | 10+ occurrences | | SignUpForm step indicator | `rounded-full` | 1 | | AuthLeftPanel testimonial cards | `rounded-[14px]` | 1 | | AuthLeftPanel avatar stack | `rounded-full` | 5 | | Social auth buttons | `rounded-[10px]` | 2 | | Back/Cancel buttons | `rounded-[10px]` | Multiple | **Problem:** Tailwind config defines `borderRadius` tokens (`lg`, `md`, `sm`) but auth components use arbitrary `[10px]` and `[14px]` values instead. **Recommendation:** Update Tailwind config with auth-specific radius or standardize all to use `rounded-md`. --- #### 4. MISSING DARK MODE SUPPORT ON SOCIAL AUTH BUTTONS **SEVERITY: HIGH** - Light mode only social buttons break in dark mode **File:** `SocialAuthButtons.tsx:57-87` ```jsx className="...bg-white...text-gray-600...dark:bg-card dark:text-gray-300..." ``` **Issues:** - Uses hardcoded `bg-white` + `text-gray-600` (not `text-foreground`) - Dark mode: `dark:bg-card` + `dark:text-gray-300` (not `text-foreground`) - Should use semantic color variables from design system - `border-gray-300` in hover state not defined in Tailwind config **Fix needed:** Replace with: ```jsx className="...bg-background text-foreground border-border hover:bg-accent..." ``` --- #### 5. MISSING FOCUS STATES AND ACCESSIBILITY **SEVERITY: HIGH** - Keyboard navigation support incomplete | Component | Issue | Line(s) | |-----------|-------|---------| | SignInForm.tsx | Forgot password link: no focus visible ring | 139 | | SignInForm.tsx | "Start free trial" link: no focus visible ring | 162 | | SignUpForm.tsx | "Sign in" link: no focus visible ring | 290 | | ForgotPasswordForm.tsx | Back button: no focus visible ring | 55 | | All remember-me/checkbox inputs | Using native `` without styled focus | 129-134 | **Missing from all auth components:** - `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring` on text buttons - Proper focus styles on custom checkboxes - Tab order consistency - Focus trap management in modal-like forms --- #### 6. MISSING ARIA LABELS AND SEMANTIC HTML **SEVERITY: MEDIUM** - Accessibility for screen readers | Component | Missing ARIA | Line | |-----------|-------------|------| | AuthLeftPanel.tsx:20, 42 | Avatar elements have no `aria-label` | 42 | | SignInForm.tsx:129 | Checkbox has no `aria-label` (only visible text) | 129 | | ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:64 | Mail icon decorative but no `aria-hidden` | 65 | | SocialAuthButtons.tsx:57, 73 | Buttons have text but no `aria-label` for icon-only states | 62, 77 | | SignUpForm.tsx:159 | Arrow icon (→) should be `aria-hidden` | 160 | --- #### 7. INCONSISTENT INPUT FIELD STYLING **SEVERITY: MEDIUM** - Form inputs override base component styling **Base Input component** (`input.tsx:12-14`): ``` rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-base focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 ``` **Auth form inputs override with:** ``` h-[46px] rounded-[10px] border-border bg-background px-3.5 text-[14px] focus-visible:border-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500/10 ``` **Issues:** - Custom height `h-[46px]` (should use standard h-10 or h-11) - Custom padding `px-3.5` (non-standard) - Custom text size `text-[14px]` (Tailwind uses `text-sm` = 14px, but hardcoded) - **Custom focus ring colors:** `focus-visible:border-indigo-500 focus-visible:ring-indigo-500/10` override the design system's `ring` variable - Missing `ring-offset-2` from base component --- #### 8. HARDCODED TEXT COLORS INSTEAD OF SEMANTIC VARIABLES **SEVERITY: MEDIUM** - Breaks color system consistency | Component | Hardcoded Color | Line | Should Use | |-----------|-----------------|------|------------| | SocialAuthButtons.tsx | `text-gray-600` | 61 | `text-foreground` | | SocialAuthButtons.tsx | `text-gray-300` | 62 | `text-foreground` | | SignUpForm.tsx | `text-green-500` | 101 | `text-success` | | SignUpForm.tsx | `text-destructive` | 253 | ✓ Correct | | TrustBadges.tsx | `text-muted-foreground/70` | 22 | ✓ Correct | --- #### 9. MISSING ERROR STATES AND VALIDATION UI **SEVERITY: MEDIUM** - No visual feedback for invalid inputs **Current state:** Forms validate but show only toast notifications - No inline error messages next to invalid fields - No red border/ring on error inputs - No `aria-invalid` attributes - Password confirmation mismatch shows below input (line 252-255) but not in real-time focus **Missing:** ```jsx // Should be added to input fields aria-invalid={!!error} aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined} // And error message container {error} ``` --- #### 10. INCONSISTENT SPACING PATTERNS **SEVERITY: LOW** - Multiple spacing scales used | Component | Spacing | Consistency | |-----------|---------|-------------| | Form container margin | `mb-7`, `mb-6` | Inconsistent (7 vs 6) | | Label to input gap | `space-y-1.5` | Consistent ✓ | | Form fields gap | `space-y-4` | Consistent ✓ | | SignUpForm step gaps | `gap-3` (buttons) | Non-standard | | TrustBadges gap | `gap-5` | Non-standard | | Avatar stack gap | `gap-2.5` | Non-standard | **Recommendation:** Define spacing scale in Tailwind config. --- #### 11. ANIMATION PERFORMANCE CONCERNS **SEVERITY: LOW** - Animations properly configured but could be optimized **Current animations** (tailwind.config.ts:93-107): - `auth-glow`: 8s infinite, uses `translate + scale` - `auth-glow-reverse`: 6s infinite, uses `translate + scale` **Issue:** `transform` animations are OK but creating multiple animated elements stacked: - AuthLeftPanel.tsx:110 - First glow element - AuthLeftPanel.tsx:111 - Second glow element On low-end devices, this could cause jank. Consider using `will-change: transform` or reducing animation duration. --- #### 12.
